Determine the overall program plan, budget, structure, schedule and resourcing for each priority launch, market by market — registration route, licence holder or agent, documentation and localisation requirements, enablement, demo instruments and target activation dates. Drive and deliver results according to agreed project scope, cost, quality and timeline milestones. Take accountability for risk assessment, identifying critical-path dependencies early and communicating them clearly to stakeholders at country, regional and global level. Serve as the direct contact between channel partners, specialist regulatory partners and Agilent project stakeholders. Support channel partners in implementing launch readiness: product and application training, competency certification, demo instrument allocation and installation, ordering and inventory access, and target account planning. Identify, qualify, onboard and manage third-party regulatory and registration partners to agreed deliverables and service levels. Track program costs and expenses against defined metrics, communicate deviations, and monitor launch performance against the business case. Own the costing of country registration and readiness programs, including third-party scopes of work, and ensure delivery within approved budgets. Build and maintain relationships with channel partners, regulatory partners and country commercial organizations. Establish launch governance for the region: a single readiness view by product and country, with clear owners and escalation paths. Partner contracts, pricing and commercial performance management remain with country commercial and channel management. Regulatory strategy, submissions and regulatory decisions remain with Regulatory Affairs. This position owns the program execution that brings these together. Experience directing external vendors, consultants or agencies to deliverables and service levels. Willingness to travel approximately 40% within the region. Preferred Experience with cell analysis, genomics or pathology product lines. Commercial enablement at scale: partner training, competency certification and demo fleet planning across an indirect channel. Working knowledge of diagnostic instrument regulatory pathways, including CDSCO and ASEAN regimes, as an informed program manager working alongside regulatory specialists.
